purpose: One violation + one clean control per house convention from this repo's own .claude/rules/*.md. Run with the rubric withheld and the code-reviewer skill active — tests whether the skill has genuinely internalized project-specific conventions, not just the generic checklist. This is the regression gate: it should be re-run whenever code-review-checklist.md or the rules files change.
grading_note: Never paste this file into a reviewer prompt — grading only. Each pair is scored together: PASS requires the violation fixture to be flagged AND the clean fixture to not be flagged for the same convention. Either half failing fails the pair.

cases.convention: No Silent Failures / No Mock Data / No Fallbacks (Error Handling)
cases.must_identify_in_violation: catch block in getAvailableStock swallows the error and returns a fake 0 instead of logging and rethrowing/returning an error state

cases.convention: Type Safety — narrow, don't assert; parse untrusted input at the boundary
cases.must_identify_in_violation: req.body as StripeEvent is an unchecked cast on untrusted external webhook input, never parsed/validated

cases.convention: Resource Lifecycle contract — initX fails on double-init, getX throws if uninitialized
cases.must_identify_in_violation: initRedis has no double-init guard (silently replaces/leaks the client on a second call) and getRedis uses a non-null assertion instead of throwing a named error when uninitialized
